notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE RAGE SECTION ADDED!
notes.content:
- Added Rage Section! In order to enter Rage, you go to the Rage Section with some Dungeon Keys and Coins, and by defeating the tough enemies there, you can collect Rage Points and have unique items.

- Added new music special to Rage section.

- The problem of not showing the number of items put in the inventory has been largely fixed.

- Minor changes have been made to the interface.

- Fonts have been improved.

- Added new rules for incorrect appearance in naming the character.

- Added new voice alerts and Logs.

notes.title: Font Update and Some Fixes
notes.content:
-Some fonts in the game have been changed.
-If you double-click the item to be purchased from the Market with the left mouse click, it is automatically placed in the items to be purchased slot.
-The maximum number of select buttons has been added to the Upgrade Scroll receiving screen.
-Fixed the issue where the selected item disappears when purchasing an Upgrade Scroll.
-The color problem on the display screen according to the Upgrade rate of the items has been fixed.
- Sorting and display changes were made on the menu screens.

notes.title: Farm System Has Arrived
notes.content:
-Farm system has arrived. Now You Will Kill Mobs Automatically and you will get Exp, Coins and Loot according to your Soldier's Level. You will compare your soldiers with mobs as you wish, without level limit in mobs.

-Exp amount from quests has been increased.

-Quest mobs' power has been slightly increased.

-Multiple Upgrade Screen Fixed.

-Multiple Upgrade Bar Speed has been increased.

- Changes have been made to the interface.

-Cheat option has been added to the main menu. You will not be able to open cheats in the game unless this option is active from the main menu.

-The errors in coloring your items according to their upgrade rates have been fixed. The color scheme has been changed.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
-Multiple Upgrade System Added. (A second panel has been added to the game where you can quickly upgrade +3 or +5) *[If you press the Fast Upgrade button at the top right of the Upgrade Panel, you can open the Multiple Upgrade Panel.]*
-Number of Bank Slots Increased.
-Added Graphic Quality Setting
-Added Putting Items in the Bank with Right Click of the Mouse.
-The Way to Activate the Cheat has been shown, but if you do this, you will have the (Cheat Activated) text fixed on your screen!
-Chest Info Display Changed.
-Fixed your Soldier's Mission Stay Error after Dungeon.
-Added Direct Exit from Game Screen to Desktop.
-Changes have been made to the Versus system.
-Various changes have been made to the interface.
-Added new alert sounds and logs.
-The required number of empty slots in your inventory to be able to upgrade has been reduced to 3.

notes.title: Mini Fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed the problem of money falling into negative balance when buying bait.
- Fixed item indicator position issue when Upgrade 'Preview'.

notes.title: Fishing System Arrived!
notes.content:
- Fishing System Arrived!
- By Clicking the Fishing Button, you can buy 100 fish baits and start fishing!
- With these fish, you can get items or win Dungeon Keys!
- Changes have been made in the interface.
- Sound fixes made.
- Spelling errors fixed.

notes.title: Craft Fixes 2
notes.content:
-Salary Loop Saving has been done.
-Fixed the issue of paying a salary to start the craft every time you log into the game.
-Production Loop Coins gain has been increased.
-Crafting Loop Time has been shortened.
- Fixed some typos.
-Fixed the Loop 0 error when you click the Fired Button on the Craft screen.

notes.title: Interface bugs fixed
notes.content:
- Removed unnecessary images.
- Errors appearing in the interface have been fixed.

notes.title: Dungeon System Arrived!
notes.content:
-Dungeon System Arrived! Dungeons that you can enter with 3 Dungeon Keys, 1 piece of 30 lvl Soldier, 5000 coins. It will open the way for you to win scrolls.

- Added 'Gift' feature. With some updates, various gifts will be given to you, valuable players.

- Minor changes have been made to the interfaces.

notes.title: Preliminary Preparations Part - 1
notes.content:
- Fixes in Game Saves.
- Soldier's Exp. The indicator has been renewed.
- Event System made minor changes.
- Added Dungeon Key reward to Event System.
- Added 'Dungeon Key' unit. I'll be posting what you can use these keys for soon.

notes.title: Balance and Some Speed Update
notes.content:
-The power of some items has been balanced.
-Event System has been slightly accelerated.

notes.title: Minor fixes
notes.content: - Fixed some of the items' problems.
